tasks.label: ULIMS: Compile
args: $compiler = if ($env:JAVA_HOME) { Join-Path $env:JAVA_HOME 'bin\javac.exe' } else { 'C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-21.0.6.7-hotspot\bin\javac.exe' }; if (-not (Test-Path $compiler)) { Write-Error 'JDK not found. Set JAVA_HOME to your JDK installation.'; exit 1 }; $output = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'out'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $output | Out-Null; $sources = Get-ChildItem (Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'src') -Recurse -Filter *.java | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; & $compiler -d $output $sources; exit $LASTEXITCODE
